instruction.text: Which words are connectives, and which words are verbs? Sort the words into the correct categories.
instruction.sound: Which words are connectives, and which words are verbs? Sort the words into the correct categories.

wrong.text: Remember, connectives are joining words and verbs are doing words.

instruction.text: Fill in the gap with the correct connective.

atoms.a: ssml: It is dark, <break time='500ms'/>blank<break time='500ms'/>,  I am tired.
atoms.b: It is dark ((but ++and)) I am tired.
atoms.finishSound: It is dark and I am tired.

atoms.a: ssml: I got a new dress, <break time='500ms'/>blank<break time='500ms'/>,  I don’t like the colour pink.
atoms.b: I got a new dress ((++but and)) I don’t like the colour pink.
atoms.finishSound: I got a new dress, but I don’t like the colour pink.

atoms.a: ssml: My teacher is nice, <break time='500ms'/>blank<break time='500ms'/>,  she is very helpful.
atoms.b: My teacher is nice ((but ++and)) she is very helpful.
atoms.finishSound: My teacher is nice and she is very helpful.

atoms.a: ssml: I woke up late, <break time='500ms'/>blank<break time='500ms'/>, I was still on time for school.
atoms.b: I woke up late ((++but and)) I was still on time for school
atoms.finishSound: I woke up late, but I was still on time for school.

atoms.a: ssml: I love cheese, <break time='500ms'/>blank<break time='500ms'/>, I am allergic.
atoms.b: I love cheese ((++but and)) I am allergic.
atoms.finishSound: I love cheese, but I am allergic.

atoms.a: ssml: I like to swim, <break time='500ms'/>blank<break time='500ms'/>,  I am good at it
atoms.b: I like to swim ((but ++and)) I am good at it.
atoms.finishSound: I like to swim and I am good at it.
